0022600037.text: The Atlanta Hawks (7-5, 1st in the Southeast, 5th in the East) are 4-2 on the road and have lost their most recent game, while the Chicago Bulls (1-8, 14th in the East) have lost seven straight and are 0-3 at home. Atlanta is without Asa Newell (toe), Henri Veesaar (knee), Keshon Gilbert (knee inflammation), and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), and Chicago is without Tobe Awaka (back). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Hawks lost all three meetings in 2025-26, most recently 126-123 in Atlanta on December 23, 2025.
